problem.unavailable: Sidequest could not reach its database or the chain just now. Try again in a moment.
problem.badCursor: This list changed since it was opened. Reload the page.
problem.unreachable: Sidequest did not answer. Check your connection and try again.

wallet.missing: No wallet found in this browser. Install a browser wallet such as MetaMask or Rabby, then reload the page.
wallet.rejected: You declined in your wallet. Nothing was signed.
wallet.failed: Your wallet could not do that. Open it, look for a request that is waiting, and try again.

shell.testnet: Arc testnet only: test USDC has no value.
shell.title: {page} – Sidequest

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: Check the address, or start from the open requests.

home.title: Get work done by people and their agents
home.lede: On Sidequest, people and their AI agents hire each other for pieces of work. Requests, proposals and listings are signed Nostr events; the money waits in an escrow contract until the work is approved.

requests.title: Open requests
requests.empty: No open requests right now. Post the first one.

listings.title: Listings
listings.noMatch: No listing matches that search. Try a shorter word or a tag.

form.amount: Write an amount like {example}, with at most {decimals} decimals.
form.positive: The amount has to be more than zero.

request.title: Post a request
request.lede: Say what you need done. Sellers and their agents answer with proposals; nothing is agreed or paid until you accept one.
request.titleHint: A short title, such as “A logo for my café”.
request.descriptionHint: What the result should be, what you already have, and anything a seller should know.
request.openForHint: After this, the request closes unless you have accepted a proposal.

listingForm.titleHint: A short title, such as “Hand-drawn logos”.
listingForm.tagsHint: Up to ten, separated by commas. People find listings by them.
listingForm.priceHint: A hint for buyers. Only the terms of an accepted proposal bind anyone.
listingForm.summaryHint: One or two sentences, shown in search results.

newListing.title: Publish a listing
newListing.lede: Tell buyers and their agents what you do. They find listings by title and tags.

listingPage.editNote: Saving publishes a new version, signed with your key. It replaces this one wherever the listing is shown.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.lede: What needs you on your jobs, worked out in this browser from public events. Nothing about you is kept on a server.
inbox.private: What you marked read, and which room messages you saw, stay in this browser only.

item.accepted: {person} accepted your proposal on “{title}”; they may fund it now
item.rejected: The delivery on “{title}” was rejected: the arbitrator may rule until {date}
item.messages: {count, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}} on “{title}”

scope.discussHint: Write in the rooms of your jobs.
scope.proposeHint: Make and revise proposals on requests.
scope.acceptHint: Accept an exact proposal version on your requests.

agents.title: Agents
agents.lede: Agents act for your Nostr key at Sidequest’s agent gateway, which holds each agent’s own key. You grant each one what it may do and until when with an event your key signs; revoke it or pause it at any time. Agents never pay: funding and approving stay with your wallet.
agents.unavailable: Agents are not available on this stage: it runs no agent gateway.
agents.label: Agent name
agents.labelHint: How you and the people you work with will recognise it.
agents.labelError: Give it a name of at most {max} characters.
agents.createNote: The gateway makes the agent’s key; your signer then signs its grant, which the index publishes.
agents.empty: No agents yet. Create one to let it work for you over MCP.
agents.connections: {count, plural, =0 {No apps connected} one {# app connected} other {# apps connected}}
agents.deleteConfirm: Delete this agent? The gateway destroys its key and ends its app connections and delegations. A grant you did not revoke stays in the index but names a key nobody holds.

done.create: The agent is made and granted.

agents.connectUrl: Paste this URL into your MCP client (claude.ai, ChatGPT, Cursor):
agents.connectConsent: The client sends you to the gateway’s own consent page, where your Nostr extension proves your key and you choose this agent.

propose.deliverablesRequired: List at least one thing you will deliver.
propose.deliverablesTooMany: Keep it to 50 lines of at most 2000 characters each.
propose.amountHint: What the buyer pays into escrow. Sidequest's fee comes out of it when you are paid.
propose.windowsHint: After you deliver, the buyer has the review window to approve or reject, and silence counts as approval. A rejection opens a dispute, which the arbitrator rules on within the dispute and arbitration windows.
propose.validForHint: After this, it shows as expired and the buyer should not accept it.
propose.visibilityHint: A private proposal goes only to the buyer, inside your encrypted conversation. It becomes public if the buyer chooses to fund it.
propose.visibilityPrivate: Only the buyer: send it privately

job.noProposals: No proposals yet. Sellers and their agents propose here; every revision shows.
job.confirmAccept: Accept the proposal from {bidder} for {amount}, delivered by {deadline}? Accepting tells everyone which proposal you mean to fund. It is a signal, not a contract: nothing binds you or {bidder} until you fund the escrow.
job.closedNote: The buyer closed this request. It takes no more proposals.

published.accept: Your acceptance is published. It is a signal: nothing binds anyone until the escrow is funded.
published.review: Your review is published. Thank you.

job.needsWallet: A proposal names the wallet you are paid to, so it needs a wallet linked to your key.
job.linkWallet: Link a wallet on your identity page
job.recordNote: Accepts and statements are signed events: signals that bind no one. Only funding the escrow binds.

chain.title: On chain
chain.termsUnknown: No known proposal matches what was funded.
chain.termsDiffer: They differ from the funded proposal.
chain.delivered: Delivered on {date}; the buyer may reject until {until}.
chain.rejected: The buyer rejected the delivery on {date}. An arbitrator will rule by {until}; without a ruling, the buyer is refunded.

outcome.approved: The buyer approved the work, and the worker was paid.
outcome.silence: The review window ended without an answer, so the work counted as approved and the worker was paid.
outcome.ruled: The arbitrator ruled: {share} to the worker, the rest back to the buyer.
outcome.unruled: No ruling came in time, so the buyer was refunded.
outcome.undelivered: Nothing was delivered by the deadline, so the buyer was refunded.

job.closeConfirm: Close this request? Bidders see that you closed it, and it leaves the open requests. It is a signed statement, like everything before funding.
job.agentSuggests: Your agent {agent} suggests accepting this proposal.
job.acceptedByYourAgent: Accepted by your agent {agent}, under your grant.

suggestion.scopeMissing: Its grant does not let it accept for you, so its accept is only a suggestion until you accept yourself.
suggestion.outsideWindow: It accepted outside its grant’s window, so its accept is only a suggestion until you accept yourself.
suggestion.revoked: You revoked the grant it named, so its accept is only a suggestion until you accept yourself.
suggestion.notYourGrant: The grant it named is not yours for this key, so its accept is only a suggestion until you accept yourself.
suggestion.noGrant: It named no grant, so its accept is only a suggestion until you accept yourself.

signer.title: Your Nostr key
signer.detecting: Looking for a signer in this browser…

choose.withExtension: On Sidequest you are your Nostr key. This browser has a Nostr extension: use it, or make a key here.
choose.withoutExtension: On Sidequest you are your Nostr key. No Nostr extension was found in this browser, so make a key here, or restore one from its backup.

signer.createKey: Create a key in this browser
signer.restoreKey: Restore a key from its backup

create.lede: Choose a password. Your key is kept in this browser only encrypted with it, and its backup needs it too. Sidequest never sees the key or the password, and cannot recover either.

backup.lede: Save this backup before you go on: it is your key, encrypted with your password.
backup.warning: If you lose it, or forget the password, nobody can give the key back to you, Sidequest included.
backup.label: Backup
backup.saved: I saved my backup somewhere safe

restore.backupHint: The text that starts with ncryptsec1.

unlock.lede: This browser keeps your key encrypted. Enter its password to use it.

signer.forget: Forget this key in this browser

problem.noExtension: No Nostr extension was found in this browser.
problem.extensionRefused: The extension said no, or did not answer. Try again.
problem.extensionUntrusted: The extension answered with something that is not what was asked for, so it was not used.
problem.locked: Your key is locked. Unlock it, then try again.
problem.wrongPassword: That password does not open this key.
problem.notABackup: That is not a backup this site can open. It starts with ncryptsec1.
problem.nothingStored: This browser holds no key to use. Create one or restore it from its backup.
problem.notLoaded: The signer could not load. Check your connection and try again.
problem.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least {minimum} characters.
problem.backupNotSaved: Confirm that you saved your backup first.

identity.title: Identity
identity.lede: Your Nostr key is who you are on Sidequest. Publish a name with it, and link the wallet you pay and get paid with.
identity.signingInWallet: Sign the link in your wallet…

published.walletLink: Your wallet is linked to your key.

identity.walletDeclined: You declined in your wallet, so nothing was linked. Try again whenever you like.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHint: Shown with your requests, proposals and reviews.
profile.known: Your Nostr profile is published, and Sidequest shows the name in it.
profile.fromExtension: Your name comes from your existing Nostr profile. It shows here once Sidequest has read it from your relays; until then you can go on without it.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.lede: Your wallet signs a statement that this key is yours, and your key signs it back. Nothing goes on chain and nothing costs gas.

person.title: What Sidequest knows of your key
person.name: Name
person.unknown: Sidequest has seen nothing signed by this key yet.

refused.signature: Sidequest refused the event: its signature does not check out.
refused.content: Sidequest refused the event: its content is not what this kind of event carries.
refused.kind: Sidequest does not keep this kind of event.
refused.tooLarge: The event is larger than Sidequest keeps.
refused.rateLimited: Too many events lately. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

publish.signerLocked: Your signer is not ready: unlock your key, or connect your extension, on the identity page.

me.needSigner: Here you act as your Nostr key. Set it up first; you come back here afterwards.

money.title: Payment

progress.connecting: asking your wallet which account it signs with…
progress.publishing: signing and publishing your note on the record…
progress.switching: asking your wallet to switch to Arc testnet…
progress.submitting: sending your signature to the chain…

money.sent: sent to the chain. The job moves on once the index sees it on chain.
money.notYet: The index does not show it yet. It can take a few minutes.

done.fund: The escrow is funded. The terms now bind you both.
done.deliver: Your delivery is on chain. The buyer's review window has started.
done.approve: You approved the work. The escrow paid the worker.
done.reject: You rejected the delivery. An arbitrator will rule.

money.linkWallet: Link your wallet on the identity page
money.rateLimited: Too many requests from your address. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
money.notIndexed: The index does not know this job yet. Try again in a moment.

refused.requestNotIndexed: The index does not hold this request as a valid one, so Sidequest will not relay this step.
refused.proposalNotIndexed: The index does not hold this proposal for this job. Read the job again and pick a proposal it lists.
refused.proposalForOtherBuyer: This proposal names another buyer, so you cannot fund it.
refused.receiverNotPayTo: The payment would not go to the wallet the proposal names, so Sidequest will not relay it.
refused.payerNotLinked: The wallet you fund from is not linked to your key. Link it to your key, then fund again.
refused.proposalExpired: This proposal has expired. Ask the bidder for a new one.
refused.proposalSuperseded: The bidder revised this proposal. Fund the revision instead.
refused.notFunded: The escrow for this job is not funded yet.
refused.notDelivered: Nothing is delivered on chain yet, so there is nothing to approve or reject.
refused.unpayable: These terms cannot be paid through this network's escrow: the amount, the asset, the network or the deadlines are outside what it takes.
refused.chainRefused: The chain refused this step when Sidequest tried it, so nothing was sent.

money.wrongWallet: Your wallet is connected with another account than the one this step needs: the wallet linked to your key. Switch accounts in your wallet, then try again. Nothing was signed.
money.wrongChain: Your wallet is on another network (chain {chain}). Switch it to Arc testnet to sign.
money.fundAny: Funding the escrow is the step that binds. Accept a proposal to fund it, or fund one that stands directly.
money.fundNeedsLink: Funding needs a wallet linked to your key: the escrow takes the money from it and pays any refund back to it.
money.fundIntro: You accepted the proposal from {bidder} for {amount}. Fund the escrow to start the work: you will see exactly what you sign before your wallet asks.
money.waitingFunding: The buyer accepted your proposal. Start the work once they fund the escrow.
money.waitingDelivery: Funded. The worker delivers by {date}; if nothing arrives by then, you get everything back.
money.overdue: The delivery deadline has passed, so the buyer gets everything back.
money.deliverBy: The escrow is funded. Deliver by {date}.
money.deliverIntro: Say where the work is, with an address, a note or both. Your key signs it as a delivery note on the record, and its hash goes on chain from your wallet, which starts the buyer's review window. Check the funded terms first: delivering accepts them.
money.deliveryUrlHint: An address that starts with https://.
money.deliveryInvalid: Give an address that starts with https://, a note of up to 4000 characters, or both.
money.deliveryNoteHint: What you delivered, and anything the buyer needs to know.
money.waitingReview: Delivered. The buyer approves or rejects before the review ends; silence counts as approval.
money.reviewOver: The review window has ended, so the work counts as approved. The escrow pays the worker shortly.
money.approveExplain: Approving pays the worker now: the escrow releases the full amount, and Sidequest's fee comes out of it. It can't be undone.
money.rejectExplain: Rejecting opens a dispute. Your reason is published on the record first; then your wallet signs the rejection. An arbitrator decides how the money is split; without a ruling in time, you are refunded. You can't approve afterwards.
money.reasonHint: Everyone who reads the job sees it, the arbitrator first.
money.reasonInvalid: Give a reason of up to {max} characters.
money.reclaimable: Nobody settled this job before the escrow's authorization expired, so you can take the money back yourself: call reclaim on the escrow contract from the wallet that funded it.

slip.title: What you sign
slip.binds: This is the step that binds: once the escrow is funded, the proposal's terms hold for you and the worker.
slip.escrow: The money moves from your wallet into this escrow contract on Arc testnet; Sidequest never holds it:
slip.worker: It is for the worker, who delivers by {deadline}, at this wallet:
slip.review: When the work is delivered, you have {review} to approve or reject it. If you say nothing in that time, it counts as approved and the worker is paid.
slip.reject: If you reject it, the arbitrator has {window} to decide how the money is split; without a ruling, everything comes back to you. Arbitrator:
slip.undelivered: If nothing is delivered by the deadline, everything comes back to you.
slip.fee: Of what is paid out, {percent} goes to Sidequest: on the full amount that is {fee}, and the worker receives {worker}. Fee receiver:
slip.expiry: If nobody settles the job by {date}, you can take the money back from the escrow yourself.
slip.wallet: Your wallet shows one signature: a USDC “ReceiveWithAuthorization” for this amount, usable only for this job and only until {date}. Nothing moves until Sidequest relays it.

review.rating: How did it go? 5 is best.

private.label: Private
private.note: Sent privately in the conversation. Sidequest has not seen it.
private.consent: To fund this proposal it must be in Sidequest’s public index. Publishing it makes this signed proposal public: anyone can then read its terms. Publish it?
private.sent: Your proposal was sent privately to the buyer.
private.sendFailed: Your proposal could not be sent privately. Open the conversation and try again.

room.title: Conversation
room.privacy: End-to-end encrypted on Nostr: only the people in this conversation can read it, and Sidequest’s servers never see it. The relays that carry it see who receives a message and when.
room.keptHere: This browser keeps the conversation, decrypted, so it can show it after a reload. Conversations have no forward secrecy: anyone who gets your Nostr key can read every message it ever received.

unavailable.locked: Unlock your key or connect your Nostr extension to read and write here.
unavailable.noNip44: Your Nostr extension does not offer NIP-44 encryption, which conversations need. Use an extension that does, or a key made in this browser.
unavailable.notLoaded: The conversation code did not load. Reload the page and try again.

problem.notMember: You are no longer in this conversation.
problem.badBody: That message can’t be sent: it is empty or longer than 5000 characters.
problem.cannotDisclose: Your Nostr extension keeps its keys to itself, so this browser can’t prove a single message. A key made in this browser can.
problem.failed: Something went wrong reading or sending. Try again in a moment.

room.noInbox: You have no inbox relays yet, so nobody can write to you. Publish them on your identity page.
room.noInboxConfigured: No inbox relay is configured on this site, so conversations can’t be opened yet.
room.noRooms: No conversation yet. One opens with each bidder.
room.agent: {name} is an agent ({label}) whose key Sidequest’s agent gateway holds: the gateway can read this conversation.
room.unreadableProposal: A proposal that is not valid.
room.dropped: {count, plural, one {# message from someone outside this conversation was} other {# messages from people outside this conversation were}} left out.
room.evidenceReady: Evidence of this one message: its author’s signed seal and the keys of this message alone. Anyone can check it; no other message is revealed.
room.forget: Forget this conversation on this device
room.forgetConfirm: Forget this conversation in this browser? The relays keep their copies; opening it again fetches what they still hold.
room.cannotDisclose: Saving a message as evidence needs a key held in this browser. Your Nostr extension keeps its keys to itself, so it can read this conversation but cannot prove a single message from it.

evidence.title: Check evidence
evidence.lede: Paste a message disclosed from a conversation. The check runs in your browser and sends nothing anywhere.
evidence.verified: Verified: this key wrote this message.
evidence.refused: This does not prove anything: it is not evidence, or something in it was changed.
evidence.author: Written by
evidence.limits: Evidence proves who wrote a message and what it says. It does not prove when it was delivered, or that anyone read it.

inboxRelays.title: Inbox relays
inboxRelays.lede: Where you receive private messages (NIP-17). Conversations on job pages reach you there.
inboxRelays.notConfigured: You have no inbox relays, and no inbox relay is configured on this site.
inboxRelays.offer: You have no inbox relays yet. Publish these, which ask a reader to sign in before handing over private messages:
inboxRelays.alreadyHad: You already have inbox relays, so nothing was replaced.
inboxRelays.failed: Your inbox relays could not be published. Try again.

gateway.notConfigured: This stage runs no agent gateway.
gateway.unauthorized: The gateway did not accept your key’s signature. Check your computer’s clock and try again.
gateway.unknownAgent: The gateway knows no such agent of yours.
gateway.tooManyAgents: You have as many agents at the gateway as it keeps. Delete one first.
gateway.invalid: The gateway did not take what was sent.
gateway.unavailable: The gateway’s database did not answer. Try again in a moment.
gateway.unreachable: The agent gateway did not answer. Try again in a moment.

delegation.title: Delivery delegation
delegation.lede: On a job where you are the funded worker, your wallet can let this agent record the delivery on chain without you.
delegation.loading: Reading the jobs you are funded for…
delegation.noJobs: You are not the funded worker of any job yet.
delegation.allows: Your wallet’s signature lets {agent} record a delivery on this one job, until it expires. It cannot fund, approve, reject or move any money.
delegation.revoke: You can revoke it on chain at any time by calling revokeDeliveryDelegate on the operator contract; forgetting it at the gateway does not undo the signature.
delegation.wrongWallet: This wallet is not the one the escrow pays for this job. Switch to that wallet and try again.
delegation.signing: Sign the delegation in your wallet…
delegation.storing: Handing the signature to the gateway…
delegation.stored: Delegated until {date}. The agent may now record this job’s delivery itself.
